programme.title: Tok Samad
programme.desc: Tok Samad, bekas kelasi kapal yang lama menetap di Amerika, kembali ke Malaysia untuk menjaga cucunya, Idris. Perwatakan moden dan bergaya beliau berbeza dengan kehidupan kampung Idris, mencetuskan situasi lucu dan konflik mesra. Ketika itu, Tok Samad juga tertarik pada gadis kampung bernama Siti.(n)

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Aisyah mengembalikan wang yang dilemparkan oleh Iskandar padanya dan menyedarkan Iskandar apa yang dilakukan pada malam itu hanya kerana statusnya sebagai isteri. Tersentak dengan itu, Iskandar terus meninggalkan Aisyah seharian. Di pejabat, Iskandar tidak dapat menumpukan sebarang kerja. Dia hanya memikirkan Aisyah dan apa yang telah berlaku antara mereka berdua. Sementara Tengku Maria sedang mengatur pertemuan kedua antara Iskandar dan Tengku Waiduri dan kali ini melibatkan keluarga mereka berdua. Tengku Waiduri memaksa pula Iskandar memulakan langkah untuk membatalkan hasrat Tengku Maria yang dilihat semakin ligat untuk menyatukan mereka. Kepulangan Iskandar ke kondo malam itu dirasakan sesuatu yang berbeza, meskipun dia masih tidak mempedulikan Aisyah tetapi dia menikmati hidangan yang disediakan oleh Aisyah untuknya dengan penuh nikmat. Tercuit rasa lapang di dadanya apabila itu adalah saat pertama dia makan semeja dengan Aisyah sejak mereka bergelar suami isteri selama 4 bulan.(n)

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Bagi mengelakkan ketegangan yang berlaku, Syarfan mengakui dirinya jatuh adalah silapnya sendiri dan bukan salah sesiapa. Antasya lega. Dia menceritakan kejadian yang berlaku siang tadi pada Najwan yang sedang mengemas kedai. Antasya masih terbayang wajah Syarfan.(n)

programme.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
programme.desc: Jazlee memaklumkan kepada ibu dan abangnya yang dia berkenan dengan Fatimah, anak Puan Habsah. Di hari Jazlan nak berangkat ke Madinah, Khatijah datang bersama Qasih untuk sama-sama menghantar beliau di Lapangan Terbang, termasuk juga Fatimah dan kakaknya Aishah tetapi malangnya Aisha tidak sempat untuk menyerahkan hadiah yang dibeli untuk Jazlan.(n)

programme.title: Tinta Syurga
programme.desc: Dokumentari istimewa ini membawa penonton melihat misi menghasilkan mushaf (naskhah al-Quran bertulis tangan) untuk percetakan al-Quran di Malaysia. Ia berkongsi tentang proses penerbitan dan penerbitan al-Quran yang perlu melalui pelbagai peringkat tapisan.(n)

programme.title: Secebis Rindu
programme.desc: Reeza pandai bermain dengan situasi hingga membuatkan Rasya selesa dengan Reeza. Rasya mula dibuai oleh perasaan atas layanan baik & mesra oleh Reeza. Reeza mahu berjumpa dengan Rasya dan jawapan Rasya pantas menjawab TIDAK. Opah beritahu Rasya yang dia nak jodohkan Rasya dengan Fahmi. Rasya terkejut sebab Rasya belum bersedia dan tak pernah cintakan Fahmi.(n)

Sementara Tengku Maria sedang mengatur pertemuan kedua antara Iskandar dan Tengku Waiduri dan kali ini melibatkan keluarga mereka berdua. Tengku Waiduri memaksa pula Iskandar memulakan langkah untuk membatalkan hasrat Tengku Maria yang dilihat semakin ligat untuk menyatukan mereka. Kepulangan Iskandar ke kondo malam itu dirasakan sesuatu yang berbeza, meskipun dia masih tidak mempedulikan Aisyah tetapi dia menikmati hidangan yang disediakan oleh Aisyah untuknya dengan penuh nikmat. Tercuit rasa lapang di dadanya apabila itu adalah saat pertama dia makan semeja dengan Aisyah sejak mereka bergelar suami isteri selama 4 bulan.(n)

programme.title: Secebis Rindu
programme.desc: Reeza pandai bermain dengan situasi hingga membuatkan Rasya selesa dengan Reeza. Rasya mula dibuai oleh perasaan atas layanan baik & mesra oleh Reeza. Reeza mahu berjumpa dengan Rasya dan jawapan Rasya pantas menjawab TIDAK. Opah beritahu Rasya yang dia nak jodohkan Rasya dengan Fahmi. Rasya terkejut sebab Rasya belum bersedia dan tak pernah cintakan Fahmi.(n)

programme.title: Judika Live in Malaysia 2025 Part 1
programme.desc: Konsert Judika Live in Malaysia 2025 yang berlangsung pada 15 November 2025 di Stadium Hoki Nasional, Bukit Jalil, menyaksikan penyanyi terkenal Indonesia itu memukau ribuan peminat menerusi persembahan bertenaga selama hampir dua jam dengan menyanyikan lebih 20 lagu popular beliau.(n)

programme.title: Judika Live in Malaysia 2025 Part 2
programme.desc: Konsert Judika Live in Malaysia 2025 yang berlangsung pada 15 November 2025 di Stadium Hoki Nasional, Bukit Jalil, menyaksikan penyanyi terkenal Indonesia itu memukau ribuan peminat menerusi persembahan bertenaga selama hampir dua jam dengan menyanyikan lebih 20 lagu popular beliau.(n)

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Syarfan tidur bermimpikan Antasya. Dia tidak lagi gelisah dan tidur meracau. Syafinaz berasa pelik. Apabila ditanya, Syarfan enggan bercerita kepada dirinya dengan lebih lanjut. Syarfan cuba mendekati Antasya bagi mengenal gadis tersebut. Namun Antasya mengendahkan dirinya. Ali mengupah orang bagi mengintip Antasya dan terkejut apabila mengetahui Antasya anak kepada Razali.(n)

programme.title: Purnama
programme.desc: Selepas Perang Dunia Kedua, Purnama mempertaruhkan nyawanya menentang ancaman komunis demi melindungi kampungnya. Namun, pengorbanannya mencetuskan rasa iri hati Yamin, yang akhirnya membawa kepada tragedi berdarah, mengorbankan Aminah dan mengakhiri persahabatan mereka.(n)

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Haziq meminta kebenaran dari Iskandar untuk membawa Aisyah berjalan di shopping mall. Tidak mahu di anggap buruk lagi, Iskandar mengizinkan Haziq membawa Aisyah yang sudah 4 bulan tidak keluar dari kondo mewah itu. Keizinan yang diberikan oleh Iskandar itu memakan perasaannya sendiri, dia tidak tahu mengapa dia harus pergi memeriksa Haziq yang keluar berduaan dengan Aisyah. Malangnya, kepala Iskandar terasa berat, badannya terasa panas dan tidak mampu untuk bergerak ke shopping mall yang besar itu. Aisyah bersama Haziq berjalan ke kedai buku. Aisyah sering bercerita pada Haziq tentang minatnya terhadap novel dan Haziq telah menghadiahkan Aisyah beberapa novel sebagai peneman masa sunyinya. Kepulangan Aisyah ke kondo mewah itu pada lewat petang mengejutkan Aisyah apabila melihat Iskandar berada di ruang tamu dalam keadaan lemah. Aisyah berhati-hati menyentuh badan Iskandar yang panas. Aisyah segera pergi ke dapur dan menyediakan makanan yang bersesuaian dengan keadaan Iskandar serta menjaga baik Iskandar. Lima hari terdampar sakit, demam yang panas membuatkan hubungan Iskandar dan Aisyah seakan rapat dan perasaan yang mencuit bahagia.(n)

programme.desc: Alawiyah dan Khatijah berdoa dan membuat solat hajat agar terbuka hati Jazlan menerima Qasih dan mereka berdua bercadang untuk menghantar Qasih mengerjakan umrah dengan Jazlan sebagai Mutawifnya tetapi sebelum tu Jazlan dan Qasih perlu ditunangkan.(n)

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Syarfan menghadiahkan percutian ke Melaka dengan menaiki kapal kepada semua staffnya termasuk cleaner. Pengawai lain menyoalkan pengawai lain yang turut membawa cleaner bersama. Syarfan menyatakan bahawa tanpa cleaner mereka tidak akan mendapat anugerah dan pujian hotel terbersih. Antasya rgembira namun risau apabila terpaksa meninggalkan ayahnya selama beberapa hari. Namun Najwan berjanji untuk melawatnya ayahnya dan berpesan supaya berhati-hati.(n)

Anggara dan Aini merupakan pasangan suami isteri yang hidup bahagia. programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Terasa bagai ada sinar baru buat seorang wanita bernama Aisyah. Namun dia tidak dapat meyakinkan hati bahawa cintanya pada Iskandar itu akan membawa kebahagiaan kerana tidak ada satu perkataan pun yang pernah muncul dari mulut Iskandar tentang perasaan Iskandar sendiri. Pun begitu, layanan Iskandar pada Aisyah kian berubah. Dia tidak lagi memarahi Aisyah malah hanya mendiamkan diri jika ada kesalahan yang dilakukan Aisyah. Setiap kali pulang lewat dari kerja, tanpa sedar langkah Iskandar akan terus ke bilik Aisyah untuk melihat wajah seorang isteri yang tidak pernah mendapat belaian ikhlas seorang suami. Namun, keegoan Iskandar dalam meneka perasaannya membuatkan Aisyah terus hidup dalam sangkar mewah itu. Kehadiran Haziq ke kondo itu menerbitkan rasa cemburu dalam hati Iskandar. Namun dia tidak mampu meluahkan rasanya atas sebab jawatan CEO yang diimpikannya selama ini. Kebetulan pada hari itu, Tengku Maria datang ke kondo itu juga, Tengku Maria terkejut melihat seorang gadis berada di dalam kondo mewah milik anaknya.(n)

Namun keadaan menjadi rumit apabila Black mengungkai lebih banyak petunjuk tentang kematian Malik dan menyedari nyawanya dalam bahaya.(n)

programme.title: Black S1 EP5
programme.desc: Seorang pembunuh upahan sedang menjejakinya lalu Black menyedari masanya dalam badan Malik semakin suntuk. Dia mesti menamatkan misinya dengan cepat dan satu-satunya harapan yang dia ada adalah menyakinkan Sofia untuk membantunya. Dia terjumpa sebuah bilik rahsia di dalam rumah Malik di mana tersimpan barang-barang yang jelas sekali disorok oleh Malik. Sementara itu, Sofia nampak satu pembunuhan bakal berlaku yang mengganggu perasaannya sehingga merangsang dia untuk bertindak. Dia memujuk Black untuk pulang ke kampung halaman mereka di Seri Setia untuk menyiasat kes itu. Anehnya, penyiasatan Borhan ke atas kes Nurul Najwa juga membawanya ke Seri Setia. Di sana, dia ketemu semula rakan sekerja lamanya, yang menyimpan rahsia tentang kes dingin yang berlaku 20 tahun lalu.(n)

programme.title: Spirit Whisker: The Revenant
programme.desc: Seorang anak sulung keluarga kaya yang telah meninggal dunia tiba-tiba hidup semula selepas seekor kucing hitam misteri melompat ke atas mayatnya, yang membawa kepada kelakuannya yang pelik dan ganas yang menyebabkan keluarga itu huru-hara dan menimbulkan rahsia gelap di kalangan mereka.(n)

programme.title: Siku 12: Langkah Derhaka
programme.desc: Seorang bapa telah merahsiakan ilmu persilatan yang telah lama dipelajari daripada anaknya kerana sejarah hitam yang dilaluinya. Anaknya merupakan peninju Muay Thai dan atas desakan yang bertubi-tubi, bapa akhirnya mewariskan ilmu yang dikenali sebagai 'Jurus Siku 12 Langkah Derhaka' kepada anaknya yang akan bertanding pada pertandingan terbuka Pendang Muay Thai 2021.(n)

programme.title: Black S1 EP6
programme.desc: Di Seri Setia, Black dan Sofia bekerjasama untuk menghalang satu pembunuhan yang berpotensi untuk berlaku. Semasa berada di sana, Black terimbas kembali masa lalu Malik, satu fenomena yang membingungkannya. Pemergian mereka ini juga merupakan titik perubahan cara Sofia melihat keupayaannya. Kesanggupan Sofia menggadaikan nyawanya untuk menyelamatkan nyawa orang lain memperbaharui tanggapan Black terhadapnya. Adakah cinta mula berputik? Black tertarik dan pada masa yang sama bingung dengan perasaannya terhadap Sofia, satu perasaan yang asing buat Black, seorang yang mementingkan diri. Tetapi hari yang bersinar menjadi pudar apabila Black kembali ke rumah dan mendapati bilik tersembunyi Malik telah digeledah dan dikosongkan. Sementara itu, pembunuh upahan telah meragut nyawa seorang lagi mangsa dan Detektif Borhan mendapati kematian itu ada kaitan dengan pembunuhan Nurul Najwa.(n)

programme.title: Assasin's Target
programme.desc: Seorang wanita pembunuh beracun dalam misi pencarian dan pemusnahan terhadap seorang pemimpin spiritual yang misteri.(n)

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP15
programme.desc: Li membawa bomoh dan memulakan upacara memanggil hantu Wan Peah. Bomoh ini menggunakan ikan masin untuk memanggil lembaga Wan Peah keluar. Selepas terhidu bau ikan kering yang sangat kuat, ternyata Wan Peah muncul pergi mendapatkannya. Sebaik sahaja ternampak kelibat Wan Peah, Li, Ghani dan Yeh melarikan diri. Melihat aksi Wan Peah, bomoh terus pengsan. Oleh kerana cerita Wan Peah yang tiada penghujungnya, Cikgu Siti merancang untuk berpindah dari situ. Nurin enggan berpindah kerana dia sudah selesa dan jauh disudut hatinya tidak mahu berpisah dengan Yeh.(n)

programme.title: The Equalizer S2 EP1
programme.desc: Ketika McCall mempertimbangkan untuk menamatkan kerjanya sebagai The Equalizer, dia ditarik balik apabila dia berhadapan dengan Detektif Marcus Dante sebagai pelanggan baharu yang memerlukan bantuannya untuk mencari sekumpulan perompak bank yang tidak dapat dikesan.(n)

programme.title: Dabbe Bir Cin Vakasi
programme.desc: Rumah sebuah keluarga di Turki dirasuk roh jahat yang ingin membunuh manusia.(n)

programme.title: Rampok
programme.desc: Seorang wanita bersenjata memasuki sebuah bank untuk merompak. Setelah semua orang dijadikan tebusan, CCTV dimatikan. Pasukan polis yang diketuai oleh Inspektor Natasya tiba untuk berunding dan berhubung dengan perompak. Selepas rundingan berjaya, tiga tebusan dibebaskan. Tanpa disedari oleh pihak polis, salah seorang tebusan yang dibebaskan adalah rakan kepada perompak dan perompak itu sendiri. Para perompak mempunyai kisah silam mereka sendiri yang memaksa mereka melakukan rompakan. Apakah kisah sebenar di sebalik tindakan mereka?(n)

programme.title: J Revolusi
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Jay Zulkarnain (Haji Zul Ariffin), ketua Unit Tindakan Khas (UTK) yang digeruni penjenayah. Konflik tercetus apabila kakaknya, Dian (Nur Fazura), ditangkap pengganas misteri, Andra (Farid Kamil), yang memiliki Ultra Virus berbahaya. Jay ditugaskan menyekat ancaman virus itu sambil menyelamatkan kakaknya yang dijadikan tebusan. Namun, misi itu membawa tragedi apabila pasukannya terkorban, menimbulkan pelbagai tuduhan dan kejutan. Bersama rakan setugas, Eddie (Izara Aishah) dan Jiman (Iedil Putra), Jay berjuang menentang masa dan musuh untuk menyelamatkan Dian dan menggagalkan rancangan Andra.(n)

programme.title: Larian Terakhir
programme.desc: Haziq, seorang anak tunggal kepada Mariam yang mempunyai bakat dalam larian pantas, sering berhadapan dengan dugaan kehidupan sehinggakan dia terpaksa meninggalkan ibunya yang sakit. Tanpa disedarinya, pertemuannya dengan Jalal telah memerangkapnya dalam sebuah sindiket jenayah. Walaupun Haziq dijanjikan peluang untuk memperbaiki hidupnya, Amelia sentiasa mengawasi setiap pergerakannya dengan teliti. Larian Terakhir adalah sebuah filem yang menggabungkan genre aksi dan sukan dengan penampilan pelakon-pelakon seperti Fattah Amin, Amyra Rosli, dan Fahrin Ahmad, di mana setiap larian akan sampai ke kemuncaknya.(n)

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In China II
programme.desc: Tiba dengan kereta api di Guangzhou pada tahun 1895, ketiga-tiga mereka melawan pengikut White Lotus, yang ingin membunuh semua orang asing dan Mak Cik ke-13 yang comel dan berpakaian Eropah. Ia bukanlah pertarungan terakhir pakar kung fu Dr. Wong (Jet Li).(n)

programme.title: Repeaters
programme.desc: Tiga orang remaja berusia dua puluhan mendapati diri mereka berada dalam gelung masa yang mustahil, di mana setiap hari mereka terjaga pada hari yang sama menakutkan seperti hari sebelumnya.(n)

programme.title: Wangi
programme.desc: Nor dan suaminya, Khuzairi tinggal di sebuah banglo bersama dua anak mereka. Selepas melahirkan anak kedua, Nor pulang ke rumah dan ibunya datang untuk menjaganya. Dia perasan bahawa pembantu rumahnya, Bella telah hilang. Bella seperti adik kepada Nor dan dia tinggal bersama mereka. Suaminya mengatakan bahawa Bella telah kembali ke Amsterdam untuk berkahwin. Nor mengesyaki dan tidak lama kemudian anak-anaknya mula mempunyai kelakuan luar biasa. Anak pertama mereka suka bercakap dengan dirinya sendiri dan tidur di tempat yang rawak; suaminya menyembunyikan rahsia manakala seorang wanita tua sentiasa memberi amaran kepada Nor. Tanpa disedari oleh Nor, Bella yang hilang mungkin sedang mengintai di sudut gelap banglo itu.(n)

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP16
programme.desc: Bomoh mula memulakan upacara memanggil hantu Wan Peah. Pada ketika itu, Wan Peah sedang berehat di dalam rumah. Selepas terhidu bau ikan kering yang sangat kuat, dia terjaga dan terus mendapatkannya. Pintu rumah Wan Peah dibuka dan dia mula mengutip ikan-ikan kering yang tersusun hingga ke dalam hutan. Sebaik ternampak kelibat Wan Peah, bomoh memulakan membaca jampi mentera kononnya untuk menghalau roh jahat. Li, Ghani, Yeh, Cik Siti dan Aziz hanya melihat sahaja Wan Peah yang memandang pelik kearah mereka. Wan Peah menggeleng kepala langsung kembali pulang ke rumahnya.(n)

programme.title: Ganjil
programme.desc: Di alam mimpi, Nabila dan Mary bertemu dengan orang yang berkongsi luka mereka, diri mereka semasa kecil. Rahsia terbongkar semasa zaman kanak-kanak mereka berjalan mereka ke lorong ingatan.(n)

programme.title: The Equalizer S2 EP2
programme.desc: McCall mendapati dirinya berada dalam ancaman agensi perisikan kerajaan asing apabila rakannya Mira, anak perempuan seorang diplomat, meminta bantuan McCall untuk mencari abangnya yang hilang.(n)

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP3
programme.desc: Memaparkan Rafeeq bertekad mahu menghapuskan Afifah, supaya dia bebas dari cengkaman Zacky. Zacky berkawan baik dengan Rizq, abang tiri kepada Afifah. Bapa Afifah minta tolong Zacky dan Rizq membantunya memulih Afifah yang kini lupa ingatan dan mengalami truama. Adelia masih marahkan Afifah yang menyebabkan abangnya Zacky mengalami tekanan selepas dia memutuskan hubungan dengan Zacky. Adelia kemudiannya ke rumah abangnya, malangnya dia telah dibunuh. Zacky kembali berbaik dengan Afifah setelah gadis tersebut meminta maaf. Tanpa mengetahui sebenar Zacky ialah pembunun misteri tersebut.(n)

programme.title: Kanang Anak Langkau
programme.desc: Sebuah filem berdasarkan kisah benar Sarjan Kanang Anak Langkau, seorang pahlawan iban dan pahlawan perang yang paling terkenal di negara ini, yang berjuang dengan berani semasa pemberontakan komunis.(n)

programme.desc: Sekumpulan penjenayah terdesak mencari perlindungan di rumah yang kelihatan seperti rumah biasa - tetapi mendapati ia menempatkan sesuatu yang jauh lebih jahat, dan lebih dunia lain, daripada yang mereka sangkakan pada mulanya….(n)

programme.title: Ganjil
programme.desc: Nabila kehilangan rantai lehernya dalam mimpinya. Apabila Amry mencadangkan mereka mencari rantai di rumah Nabila, dia mendapati kebenaran yang tidak selesa.(n)

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP13
programme.desc: Pada suatu hari, Farhan mengajak 3 sahabatnya bermain sorok-sorok untuk mengingati nostalgia mereka semasa kanak-kanak. Tujuan Farhan sebenarnya adalah untuk mencari Wan Peah. Tiba-tiba, muncul Wan Peah di hadapan Farhan dan bercakap dengannya, Farhan dapat merasakan Wan Peah sebenarnya manusia biasa bukannya hantu. Oleh itu, Farhan berjanji akan membuktikan Wan Peah adalah manusia. Dia menyuarakan rasa cinta kepada Cikgu Siti.(n)

programme.title: The Equalizer S1
programme.desc: Ketika melakukan satu bantuan untuk Pengarah CIA, Suri Nance (Laila Robins), keadaan menjadi rumit bagi McCall apabila dia cuba menjejaki seorang ahli matematik British yang hilang dan mendapati dirinya terperangkap dalam perebutan antarabangsa untuk teknologi kewangan revolusioner.(n)

programme.title: Don't Blink
programme.desc: Sepuluh orang tiba di sebuah pusat peranginan pergunungan yang terpencil dan mendapati ia lengang sepenuhnya. Tanpa minyak untuk perjalanan pulang, para pengunjung terpaksa tinggal dan menyiasat misteri di sekitar pondok yang terbengkalai itu.(n)

programme.title: Black S1 EP5
programme.desc: Seorang pembunuh upahan sedang menjejakinya lalu Black menyedari masanya dalam badan Malik semakin suntuk. Dia mesti menamatkan misinya dengan cepat dan satu-satunya harapan yang dia ada adalah menyakinkan Sofia untuk membantunya. Dia terjumpa sebuah bilik rahsia di dalam rumah Malik di mana tersimpan barang-barang yang jelas sekali disorok oleh Malik. Sementara itu, Sofia nampak satu pembunuhan bakal berlaku yang mengganggu perasaannya sehingga merangsang dia untuk bertindak. Dia memujuk Black untuk pulang ke kampung halaman mereka di Seri Setia untuk menyiasat kes itu. Anehnya, penyiasatan Borhan ke atas kes Nurul Najwa juga membawanya ke Seri Setia. Di sana, dia ketemu semula rakan sekerja lamanya, yang menyimpan rahsia tentang kes dingin yang berlaku 20 tahun lalu.(n)

programme.title: Repeaters

programme.title: Assalamualaikum Subuh (L)
programme.desc: Program bual bicara keagamaan mengupas topik berkaitan dengan menghidupkan ibadah di waktu Subuh bagi meraih keberkatan dari Allah SWT.(n)

programme.title: Assalamualaikum(L)
programme.desc: Sebuah program bual bicara yang membicarakan topik-topik terkini dan menampilkan tetamu-tetamu undangan dari pelbagai bidang secara santai dan bersahaja.(n)

programme.title: Usop Wilcha Mehghonjang Makhluk Muzium
programme.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah muzium yang ingin mengadakan satu pameran “Hantu-Hantu Dunia” untuk menarik minat pengunjung. Tanpa disedari, penganjuran pameran ini mempunyai matlamat tersendiri. Melalui perancangan licik sekumpulan pengamal ilmu hitam dari Romania, pameran ini sebenarnya ingin menghidupkan kembali Raja Dracula. Mengikut kepercayaan kumpulan ini, Raja Dracula akan dapat hidup kembali dengan mendapatkan darah manusia dari setiap benua.(n)

programme.title: Jiran
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Ramlan sekeluarga yang baru berpindah di sebuah kawasan perumahan. Namun, Ramlan melarang isteri dan anaknya Tina daripada bergaul dengan jiran-jiran mereka di situ. Ramlan sendiri beranggapan bahawa dengan berlaku sombong terhadap orang, dirinya akan dipandang mulia. Kesombongan Ramlan itu akhirnya menyusahkan dirinya sendiri apabila berlaku satu insiden yang melibatkan kehilangan Tina.(n)

programme.title: Aku Ada Kau Ada ???
programme.desc: Seorang pelajar bernama Nordin Ahmad yang ingin kelihatan “cool” di mata orang lain. Walau bagaimanapun, setiap kali Nordin menjadi tumpuan, dia akan menjadi panik dan muntah. Sementara itu, Aziz pula seorang pelajar yang perasan popular yang selalu menyakat Nordin. Tina pula seorang pelajar yang baru bertukar ke kolej mereka untuk menjalani sebuah program khas untuk mengatasi sikap panas baran yang ditawarkan oleh Dr. Zida.(n)

programme.title: Darah Satria
programme.desc: Berpangkat Leftenan Muda, Ariff terlibat dalam operasi memburu komunis di hutan. Mempunyai seorang isteri bernama Rafidah, namun terpaksa ditinggalkannya bersama ibu bapanya kerana sibuk menjalankan operasi. Dalam satu operasi menentang komunis, Ariff bersama anak buahnya melalui kesukaran yang menyebabkan Ariff mengalami kecederaan manakala salah seorang daripada mereka terkorban.(n)

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?(n)

programme.title: Tipu Kanan Tipu Kiri
programme.desc: Rudy, seorang jejaka tampan yang memiliki segalanya, Isterinya bernama Wulan, seorang penyanyi terkenal di Indonesia. Malangnya dalam syarat kontrak rakamannya, Wulan tidak dibenarkan untuk berkahwin. Untuk menyembunyikan perkahwinan mereka, Rudy dan Wulan berpindah ke Malaysia. Pelbagai kejadian lucu berlaku akibat kekeliruan dan suasana kelam kabut yang terjadi akibat penipuan mereka berdua.(n)

programme.title: Leftenan Adnan
programme.desc: Adnan memutuskan untuk menjadi seorang tentera dalam pasukan Askar Melayu setelah dikunjungi anggota tentera British yang datang ke kampungnya untuk merekrut lebih ramai anak tempatan. Tidak direstui keluarga, Adnan nekad untuk mengikuti latihan ketenteraan di Port Dickson. Perjuangan Leftenan Adnan dalam mempertahankan Tanah Melayu memberikan inspirasi kepada ramai anak muda tempatan.(n)

programme.title: Pecah
programme.desc: Empat orang lelaki berjaya merompak sebuah bank tetapi malangnya salah seorang daripada mereka cedera dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital. Pada masa yang sama, seorang wanita yang menjaga orang tua di sebuah rumah orang tua, membawa salah seorang penghuninya ke hospital yang sama untuk mendapatkan rawatan. Apa yang berlaku kemudiannya ialah pembongkaran demi pembongkaran agenda tersembunyi, di samping penyiasatan daripada pihak polis pada masa yang sama.(n)

programme.title: Tuah
programme.desc: Datuk Shaari dan Shahira diselamatkan oleh seorang lelaki yang mendakwa bahawa dirinya Hang Tuah, seorang pahlawan Melayu di abad ke-15. Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.(n)

programme.title: Anak Sarawak
programme.desc: Pegawai Daerah, Azam Wasli berusaha untuk membangunkan Laka, sebuah kawasan terpencil di Sarawak. Pelbagai rintangan dihadapinya yang ingin menyatukan puak di kawasan itu. Azam turut menemui cinta bersama Mei Ling, seorang wartawan - tetapi dia diambil sebagai tebusan untuk menggugat posisi Azam. Insiden itu membawa kepada perjumpaan semula antara dua saudara.(n)

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. programme.desc: Memaparkan laporan peristiwa yang berlaku di seluruh Malaysia dalam bahasa English.(n)

programme.desc: Travelogue program that follows two hosts on their journey to discover hidden gems in Sarawak's natural beauty, including national parks, mountains, valleys, lakes, rivers, waterfalls, and islands.(n)

programme.title: Jendela Hati
programme.desc: Drama ini mengisahkan konflik rumah tangga suami isteri di mana kehidupan Luqman yang dipaksa berkahwin dengan Farah yang merupakan pasangan kembar kepada arwah isterinya, Sarah.(n)

programme.title: Barbarossa
programme.desc: During the reign of the Ottoman Empire, four brothers from Lesvos face many dangers and become the conquerors of the seas.(n)

programme.title: Borneo's Unique Building
programme.desc: Siri dokumentari yang memfokuskan kepada senibina bangunan dan infrastruktur di Sarawak, yang menampilkan dua binaan iaitu satu senibina moden/kontemporari dan satu lagi senibina tradisi/kolonial.(n)

programme.title: Joran Borneo
programme.desc: Masih mengekalkan konsep 'Majalah' travelog, JORAN BORNEO 2 akan meneruskan ekspedisinya bagi menjejaki lubuk ikan-ikan idaman pemancing di pendalaman dan di hulu BORNEO yang bersempadan Kalimantan.(n)

programme.title: Borneo Dive
programme.desc: Borneo Dive 2 will take viewers to experience the beauty of diving sites around Borneo, including Sabah, Sarawak, and Labuan. Join host Baki Zainal as he is accompanied by local celebrities who are also divers.(n)

programme.title: Salam Nusantara
programme.desc: Mengungkap lebih banyak khazanah negeri Sarawak yang masih belum lagi diketahui oleh khalayak awam khasnya tentang perkembangan tamadun masyarakat majmuk Sarawak termasuklah umat Islam di negeri ini.(n)

programme.title: Kubah Borneo

programme.title: River Tales of Borneo
programme.desc: Sarawakian show that tells forgotten stories and folktales from historical times, starting from the mouth of Rejang to Iran Mountain, focusing on ethnic groups living along the rivers.(n)

programme.desc: Tiga Pengacara, Chef Adu Amran, Fiza Frizzy dan Kelvin Yap akan menyelami dan merasai pengalaman kehidupan masyarakat lokal dari pelbagai etnik.(n)

programme.title: Guru Luar Biasa

programme.title: (L) TVS Pagi
programme.desc: TVS Pagi membawakan perkembangan menyeluruh dari dalam dan luar negara.(n)

programme.title: Temen Kondangan
programme.desc: Putri yang sering menghadiri majlis perkahwinan seorang diri akhirnya menyewa seorang lelaki untuk menjadi teman menghadiri majlis. Namun, hubungan yang pada mulanya sekadar lakonan bertukar menjadi lebih rumit apabila perasaan sebenar mula muncul.(n)

programme.title: 7 Days/24 Hours
programme.desc: Mengisahkan pasangan suami isteri, Tania dan Tyo, yang terlalu sibuk dengan kerjaya sehingga hubungan mereka semakin renggang. Selepas kedua-duanya jatuh sakit dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital yang sama, mereka akhirnya mempunyai masa bersama selama 7 hari 24 jam untuk memperbaiki hubungan, memahami satu sama lain dan menghadapi masalah yang selama ini dipendam.(n)

programme.title: Jin Notti
programme.desc: Jin Notti, seekor jin nakal dari dunia jin, dihantar ke bumi untuk belajar menjadi baik dengan membantu manusia. Namun, misinya jadi huru-hara apabila dia jatuh cinta dengan gadis manusia bernama Amy, lalu mencetuskan pelbagai situasi lucu dan romantik antara dua dunia.(n)

programme.title: The Voice of Hind Rajab
programme.desc: Mengisahkan kejadian sebenar tentang Hind Rajab, seorang kanak-kanak perempuan berusia 6 tahun yang terperangkap di dalam sebuah kereta di Gaza dan membuat panggilan kecemasan untuk mendapatkan bantuan. Filem ini mengikuti usaha sukarelawan Bulan Sabit Merah Palestin yang cuba mengekalkan talian komunikasi dengannya sambil berusaha menghantar bantuan menyelamat. Sebuah kisah menyentuh hati tentang kemanusiaan, konflik dan harapan di tengah tragedi perang.(n)

programme.title: Diari Abah
programme.desc: Rahmat dipulaukan oleh tiga anaknya, Annur, Zarif & Zakuan, setelah berkahwin buat kali kedua dengan Ashikin, ibu tunggal anak satu. Anak-anaknya menganggap kematian ibu mereka, Khalijad berpunca daripada keputusan Rahmat berkahwin lain. Namun mereka semua tersedar apabila Ashikin telah menyerahkan sebuah diari kepada mereka bertiga setelah Rahmat meninggal dunia. Tercatat dalam diari itu bahawa segala duit yang dikirimkan setiap bulan digunakan abah mereka untuk mendirikan rumah anak yatim atas permintaan arwah ibu mereka dengan nama Rumah Anak Yatim Cik Khalijah.(n)

programme.title: Me VS Mami
programme.desc: Mira terpaksa menemani ibunya, Maudy, dalam satu perjalanan jauh untuk menziarahi neneknya yang sedang tenat. Sepanjang perjalanan, hubungan mereka yang sering dipenuhi pertengkaran diuji melalui pelbagai cabaran dan pertemuan baharu, sehingga mereka akhirnya saling memahami dan mengeratkan hubungan sebagai ibu dan anak.(n)

programme.desc: Mengisahkan Aurora, seorang gadis berusia 19 tahun yang dibesarkan di Eropah oleh keluarga angkat bukan Islam. Selepas mengetahui asal-usul sebenar dirinya sebagai anak luar nikah, Aurora kembali ke Malaysia untuk mencari ibu bapa kandungnya. Dalam perjalanan tersebut, dia dibantu oleh Khaliq dan mula mengenali erti keluarga, agama serta berdepan dengan dosa silam yang menghantui ibu bapanya.(n)

programme.desc: Jin Notti, seekor jin nakal dari dunia jin, dihantar ke bumi untuk belajar menjadi baik dengan membantu manusia. Namun, misinya jadi huru-hara apabila dia jatuh cinta dengan gadis manusia bernama Amy, lalu mencetuskan pelbagai situasi lucu dan romantik antara dua dunia.(n)

programme.title: 3 Dara 2
programme.desc: Tiga tahun selepas peristiwa dalam filem pertama, Affandi, Jay dan Richard yang kini telah berkeluarga sekali lagi memandang rendah terhadap peranan isteri. Selepas pelaburan mereka gagal dan menyebabkan mereka muflis, ketiga-tiganya terpaksa menjadi suri rumah sepenuh masa sementara isteri masing-masing keluar bekerja. Pengalaman itu mengajar mereka untuk lebih menghargai pengorbanan dan peranan wanita dalam keluarga.(n)

programme.title: Balada Pencinta
programme.desc: Sebuah kisah cinta terlarang antara Amir, bekas ahli mafia, dan Aisyah, seorang pelajar seni. Amir ingin memulakan hidup baru sebagai pemuzik jalanan, dan pada suatu hari, dia bertemu dengan Aisyah yang juga berasal dari keluarga kaya.(n)

programme.title: Aku Bukan Gila
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Andra yang pergi bercuti ke Wales dan bertemu dengan beberapa individu yang mengubah perjalanan hidupnya. Di sebalik kehidupan yang kelihatan normal, dia berdepan dengan trauma dan konflik berkaitan kesihatan mental yang mempengaruhi dirinya.(n)

programme.title: Ada Apa Dengan Dosa
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Aurora, seorang gadis berusia 19 tahun yang dibesarkan di Eropah oleh keluarga angkat bukan Islam. Selepas mengetahui asal-usul sebenar dirinya sebagai anak luar nikah, Aurora kembali ke Malaysia untuk mencari ibu bapa kandungnya. Dalam perjalanan tersebut, dia dibantu oleh Khaliq dan mula mengenali erti keluarga, agama serta berdepan dengan dosa silam yang menghantui ibu bapanya.(n)

programme.title: One, Two, Trivia
programme.desc: Sebuah program yang merungkai fakta-fakta menarik yang tersimpan dalam filem-filem klasik tempatan.(n)

programme.title: Taikun
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua lelaki bernama Tai dan Kun, sahabat baik yang hanya meminati pergaduhan dan mencuri. Apabila tabiat buruk mereka menyebabkan mereka bertembung dan memukul teruk ahli geng Pink dan Purple, Tai dan Kun kemudian direkrut oleh ketua geng yang kagum dengan kemahiran mereka.(n)

programme.title: Cinta Sedalam Rindu
programme.desc: Aluna menyangka takdirnya hanyalah sebagai anak kepada seorang pembantu rumah yang terpaksa mengorbankan cintanya demi Felicia, anak majikannya. Namun, apabila rahsia dari masa lalunya terbongkar, seluruh hidup mereka berubah sama sekali.(n)

programme.title: Band Academy
programme.desc: Band Academy ialah sebuah pertandingan bakat yang bertujuan mencari kumpulan muzik terbaik.(n)

programme.title: Tertawan Hati
programme.desc: Alya dan Alyssa ialah pasangan kembar yang terpisah sejak lahir. Selepas 25 tahun, takdir menemukan mereka semula, dan mereka terkejut melihat wajah yang begitu seiras. Pertemuan itu merapatkan hubungan mereka, namun tanpa disedari pelbagai rahsia dan konflik mula terbongkar, mengubah kehidupan kedua-duanya.(n)

programme.title: D'Academy 7
programme.desc: D' Academy 7 ialah musim ketujuh rancangan nyanyian popular Indonesia yang fokus pada muzik dangdut. Peserta dari seluruh negara bertanding dengan menyanyikan lagu dangdut, menunjukkan bakat vokal dan persembahan mereka. Sepanjang musim, mereka dinilai oleh juri profesional dan undian penonton. Siapakah yang akan menjuarai D'Academy musim ketujuh?(n)

programme.title: Qari Cilik Season 3
programme.desc: Qari Cilik Indonesia kembali untuk musim ketiga, menampilkan kanak-kanak berbakat dalam seni tilawah Al-Quran. Saksikan perjalanan para peserta muda dalam menyampaikan bacaan yang indah dan penuh makna.(n)

programme.title: 34 Hari Nyender Di Hati Ketua Khapunkhap
programme.desc: 34 Hari Nyender Di Hati Ketua Khapunkhap mengisahkan Jirayut, seorang pemuda Thailand yang datang ke Jakarta untuk mencari ibu kandungnya. Dia bertemu dengan Halda, gadis ceria yang setuju membantunya dengan niat mendapatkan warisan Jirayut. Mereka tinggal bersama selama 34 hari, tetapi konflik timbul apabila Halda memperkenalkan wanita palsu sebagai ibu Jirayut. Meski merasa dikhianati, benih cinta tumbuh antara mereka. Kini, cinta mereka diuji oleh kejujuran dan pengkhianatan.(n)

programme.title: Return of the Cuckoo
programme.desc: Twenty years previously, CHU SHA KIU (SIT KA YIN, NANCY) met an undergraduate from Hong Kong, CHUK CHIN FAI (KWOK FUNG) and they immediately fell in love with each other. However soon afterwards, FAI decided to further his study in the United States. KIU, though had just found herself pregnant, agreed reluctantly to let him go just for the sake of his future. Since then, KIU has lived with her own daughter, CHUK KWAN HO (SHEH CHARMAINE) and her adopted child, MAN CHOR (CHEUNG CHI LAM, JULIAN). Having been abandoned by her lover, CHOR's mother flied into a fury of grief and gave CHOR, who was then an infant, a corrosive substance to drink. CHOR was fortunately rescued by KIU in time but his vocal cords had become paralysed because of the serious damage. CHOR regards HO as his sister and does not realise his extraordinary passion for her until SZETO LAI SHUN (MA CHUN WAI, STEVEN) appears. HO is an affectionate girl and is always full of tender solicitude towards all. She is thus torn by the confusing emotions of love for the three men around her, CHOR, SHUN and KAM SING (TONG MICHAEL). CHOR's voice begins to recover after the vocal operation conducted by a renowned surgeon. As he feels that he is unable to bring HO any physical well-being, he withdraws and has decided to leave for Hong Kong to look for his own mother. Meanwhile, by thinking of HO's future, KIU urges HO to depart from Macau and to live with FAI. Who will win HO's heart eventually? Will KIU be left alone by HO and CHOR?(n)

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.(n)

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.(n)

programme.title: Cho Lam & His Trip Buddies & What's On Today
programme.desc: After his "One-Stroke-Wear" journey to Dongguan and Shantou, Wong Cho-lam continues his series' authentic style with another travel program. This time, however, he'll be joined by friends, and the main theme will be a series of in-depth revisites along the milestones in Cho-lam's life, uncovering the fun and warmth of everyday life. The filming locations span Fuzhou, Guangxi, and Vancouver—three distinctive places that have held significant meaning for Cho-lam at different stages of his life. Cho-lam walks through the streets and alleys with three groups of "travel friends," exploring everything from hometown connections and cultural awakening to the most important aspect—his romantic destiny—telling his unique story through travel snippets.(n)

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors.".(n)

programme.title: Cause Of Death
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan (Hera Chan) has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum (Willie Wai). And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han (Alice Wong), RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sum's approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun (Mark Ma). The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yan's buddy Sin Pui-ka (Jinny Ng) becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu (Nicholas Yuen) evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yan's career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-ka's death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased!(n)

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.(n)

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.(n)

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestants—Ho Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-sze—set aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various "outdoor experts" on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong "wild women" with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?(n)

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning (Bai Lu) went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-ning's wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Wei's (Zhang Linghe) pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin (Zhou Junwei) from getting involved in the “coming-of-age” incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei's strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels' scheme. She and Zhang Zhe (Wang Xingyue) venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi (Liu Xening) does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.(n)

MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.(n)

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. programme.title: Cho Lam & His Trip Buddies
programme.desc: After his "One-Stroke-Wear" journey to Dongguan and Shantou, Wong Cho-lam continues his series' authentic style with another travel program. This time, however, he'll be joined by friends, and the main theme will be a series of in-depth revisites along the milestones in Cho-lam's life, uncovering the fun and warmth of everyday life. The filming locations span Fuzhou, Guangxi, and Vancouver—three distinctive places that have held significant meaning for Cho-lam at different stages of his life. Cho-lam walks through the streets and alleys with three groups of "travel friends," exploring everything from hometown connections and cultural awakening to the most important aspect—his romantic destiny—telling his unique story through travel snippets.(n)

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning (Bai Lu) went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-ning's wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Wei's (Zhang Linghe) pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin (Zhou Junwei) from getting involved in the “coming-of-age” incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei's strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels' scheme. She and Zhang Zhe (Wang Xingyue) venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi (Liu Xening) does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.(n)

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.(n)

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?(n)

programme.title: Return of the Cuckoo
programme.desc: Twenty years previously, CHU SHA KIU (SIT KA YIN, NANCY) met an undergraduate from Hong Kong, CHUK CHIN FAI (KWOK FUNG) and they immediately fell in love with each other. However soon afterwards, FAI decided to further his study in the United States. KIU, though had just found herself pregnant, agreed reluctantly to let him go just for the sake of his future. Since then, KIU has lived with her own daughter, CHUK KWAN HO (SHEH CHARMAINE) and her adopted child, MAN CHOR (CHEUNG CHI LAM, JULIAN). Having been abandoned by her lover, CHOR's mother flied into a fury of grief and gave CHOR, who was then an infant, a corrosive substance to drink. CHOR was fortunately rescued by KIU in time but his vocal cords had become paralysed because of the serious damage. CHOR regards HO as his sister and does not realise his extraordinary passion for her until SZETO LAI SHUN (MA CHUN WAI, STEVEN) appears. HO is an affectionate girl and is always full of tender solicitude towards all. She is thus torn by the confusing emotions of love for the three men around her, CHOR, SHUN and KAM SING (TONG MICHAEL). CHOR's voice begins to recover after the vocal operation conducted by a renowned surgeon. As he feels that he is unable to bring HO any physical well-being, he withdraws and has decided to leave for Hong Kong to look for his own mother. Meanwhile, by thinking of HO's future, KIU urges HO to depart from Macau and to live with FAI. Who will win HO's heart eventually? Will KIU be left alone by HO and CHOR?(n)

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestants—Ho Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-sze—set aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various "outdoor experts" on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong "wild women" with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?(n)

programme.title: Cause Of Death
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan (Hera Chan) has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum (Willie Wai). And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han (Alice Wong), RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sum's approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun (Mark Ma). The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yan's buddy Sin Pui-ka (Jinny Ng) becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu (Nicholas Yuen) evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yan's career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-ka's death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased!(n)

programme.title: The Truth Within & What's On Today
programme.desc: Qi Sizhe becomes Director of Forensic Medicine for the Hecheng Criminal Police Unit, reunites with Han Feng, and investigates the truth behind his girlfriend Yu Fei's death from the drug Original Diamond three years earlier. A series of nightclub attacks, cocoon murders, medical-school specimen crimes, insurance frauds, and silencing killings all point to a new narcotic and a drug-manufacturing ring. Qi Sizhe, Han Feng, and their team uncover Professor Wu Yongchang as the mastermind and Yu Fei's true killer. Police raid the drug factory, arrest Wu and the traffickers, and close the new Original Diamond case.(n)

programme.title: Return of the Cuckoo
programme.desc: Twenty years previously, CHU SHA KIU (SIT KA YIN, NANCY) met an undergraduate from Hong Kong, CHUK CHIN FAI (KWOK FUNG) and they immediately fell in love with each other. However soon afterwards, FAI decided to further his study in the United States. KIU, though had just found herself pregnant, agreed reluctantly to let him go just for the sake of his future. Since then, KIU has lived with her own daughter, CHUK KWAN HO (SHEH CHARMAINE) and her adopted child, MAN CHOR (CHEUNG CHI LAM, JULIAN). Having been abandoned by her lover, CHOR's mother flied into a fury of grief and gave CHOR, who was then an infant, a corrosive substance to drink. CHOR was fortunately rescued by KIU in time but his vocal cords had become paralysed because of the serious damage. CHOR regards HO as his sister and does not realise his extraordinary passion for her until SZETO LAI SHUN (MA CHUN WAI, STEVEN) appears. HO is an affectionate girl and is always full of tender solicitude towards all. She is thus torn by the confusing emotions of love for the three men around her, CHOR, SHUN and KAM SING (TONG MICHAEL). CHOR's voice begins to recover after the vocal operation conducted by a renowned surgeon. As he feels that he is unable to bring HO any physical well-being, he withdraws and has decided to leave for Hong Kong to look for his own mother. Meanwhile, by thinking of HO's future, KIU urges HO to depart from Macau and to live with FAI. Who will win HO's heart eventually? Will KIU be left alone by HO and CHOR?(n)

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.(n)

programme.title: Cho Lam & His Trip Buddies & What's On Today
programme.desc: After his "One-Stroke-Wear" journey to Dongguan and Shantou, Wong Cho-lam continues his series' authentic style with another travel program. This time, however, he'll be joined by friends, and the main theme will be a series of in-depth revisites along the milestones in Cho-lam's life, uncovering the fun and warmth of everyday life. The filming locations span Fuzhou, Guangxi, and Vancouver—three distinctive places that have held significant meaning for Cho-lam at different stages of his life. Cho-lam walks through the streets and alleys with three groups of "travel friends," exploring everything from hometown connections and cultural awakening to the most important aspect—his romantic destiny—telling his unique story through travel snippets.(n)

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show (Sr.5)
programme.desc: Li Jiading (Master Ding), the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up "Master Ding's Kitchen," partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!(n)

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. "The Strongest Lifeline" helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the “Sanfu” herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.(n)

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning (Bai Lu) went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-ning's wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Wei's (Zhang Linghe) pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin (Zhou Junwei) from getting involved in the “coming-of-age” incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei's strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels' scheme. She and Zhang Zhe (Wang Xingyue) venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi (Liu Xening) does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.(n)

programme.title: Grow Grow Grow With You
programme.desc: From "Hopscotch" to "Hands Up," TVB's children's programs have accompanied children's growth, creating countless wonderful childhood memories. Veteran children's program hosts Tam Yuk-ying, Lai Chi-shan, and Gai Sai-bo have also grown up alongside you! Each episode will feature a different theme, inviting hosts from different eras to reunite and reminisce about the past. programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.(n)

programme.title: Ratman To The Rescue
programme.desc: Gossip magazine journalist Tong Leung-sing (Sammy) has unfortunately lost his left ear in a traffic accident. He gains mystical rat power after undergoing transplant surgery. Leung-sing keeps creating fake news just to benefit himself. He clashes with righteous policewoman Sung Hoi-yan (Priscilla Wong), causing both of them to lose their jobs. With the support of her uncle Ming Kwan-ngai (KK Cheung), Hoi-yan becomes a private investigator. Leung-sing is forced to help Hoi-yan with her investigation activities as Hoi-yan catches him using his mystical power to peep at goddess Ming Cheuk-kei (Zoie Tam). Gold digger Tong Mei-fun (Kamen Kong) is cruelly harassed as rich clan heir Tsui Tsun-wai (Daniel Chau) and she become foes. Mei-fun forgives Tsun-wai and offers to help him as Tsun-wai gets into a difficult situation. Leung-sing becomes increasingly arrogant as he uses to his mystical power to solve cases. Meanwhile, Hoi-yan shockingly finds out Kwan-ngai's real character. Leung-sing faces the danger of exhausting his mystical power and becoming a rat as he helps Hoi-yan.(n)

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors.".(n)

programme.title: Want To De-stress
programme.desc: Many urban dwellers are constantly striving for a living and a career, leaving no time for relaxation. The accumulated stress can quickly trigger health problems. This program invites professionals from various fields, such as aromatherapists, music therapists, color therapists, nutritionists, and psychologists, to use accessible methods, including case studies and fun quizzes, to bring out the harmony and balance of the five senses, helping viewers instantly release stress. Celebrities will also be invited to have candid conversations with the host, sharing their effective methods for coping with the heavy pressures of life and work. The program also includes many interesting stress-reduction tips to deepen viewers' understanding of the importance of stress reduction for health.(n)

programme.title: Try It? Really? (Sr.2)
programme.desc: Elena Kong once again leads the team, joining forces with Cheung Chun-long, Chu Man-han, Ng Yip-kwan, and Tseng Zhan-wang to form the "Try It Out Team," returning with acclaim after the hit first season and enthusiastic praise from netizens. This new in-depth exploration of Taiwan will see the team continue their relaxed, authentic, and down-to-earth style, guiding viewers deep into the island's heart. The team travels to Kaohsiung, Tainan, and Taipei, continuing the show's spirit by uncovering controversial shops with polarized online reviews, as well as hidden gems and little-known experiences tucked away in the city's corners. The team is committed to presenting the most genuine on-site feedback, aiming to create a practical travel guide to Taiwan that avoids pitfalls for viewers.(n)

programme.title: A Date with Goddess (Sr.2)
programme.desc: The dating reality show "A Date with Goddess" is back with a bang, and the second season's love battlefield is all upgraded! "Golden Matchmaker" Bob Lam is recruiting men from around the world to pair up goddesses Ho Pei-Chia, Kuo Pei-Wen, Chen Ruo-Si, Yu Ke-Cheng, and Yuen Ka-Man. The brave suitors face challenges like pressing the "heart-fluttering light" and a date at the Five Corners, each employing their own unique strategies to win over the goddesses. One-on-one intimate games ignite heart-pounding excitement, and a hidden goddess joins the fray, further intensifying the sparks… More challenges await, and the brave suitors strive to reach the end and capture the goddesses' hearts! In addition, the five goddesses from last season, along with celebrity guests, take turns becoming the "Peanut Team," providing live coverage of the goddesses' dates.(n)

programme.title: J Music 2026
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. The program invites popular singers as guests, who personally select their favorite new and old works, perform them live, and share their favorite tracks. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry.(n)

programme.title: Star Weekly
programme.desc: The talk show "Star Weekly" invites celebrities and industry leaders each episode, along with entertainment anchors such as Au Wing-Kuen, Hsu Wen-Hsuan, and Wang Chen-Chuan, to share their recent work plans and discuss special topics related to movies, television, and concerts, especially people and events that netizens and friends in the industry are concerned about and discussing! With so much surrounding information, the show features a special "Fact Check" segment, where guests personally respond to various rumors, allowing the parties involved to clarify the truth!(n)

programme.title: Gourmet Express Weekly
programme.desc: Hong Kong is a melting pot of global cuisine! Food anchors and hosts like Carmaney Wong,Carmen Ngai,Gillian Ng stay up-to-date with the latest culinary trends, gathering information on top-rated restaurants from various platforms. The hosts personally sample the food and provide honest reviews; they uncover hidden gems in different districts and invite long-time expatriates to visit their favorite hometown eateries; renowned chefs and food critics also guide the way, offering expert recommendations. The program features a selection of popular restaurants featured in "Food News Report," highlighting their signature dishes and delivering quick deals, ensuring viewers stay up-to-date with the most delicious and affordable dining information.(n)

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show (Sr.5)
programme.desc: Li Jiading (Master Ding), the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up "Master Ding's Kitchen," partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!(n)

programme.title: Thai Rogered (Sr.11)
programme.desc: "Thailand expert" Hu Huichong once again leads the "Tom Yum Family" members to introduce the latest travel information in Bangkok, including glamorous massage parlors with perfect photo spots, newly opened shopping malls with sky parks, and buffet restaurants hailed as the pinnacle of Bangkok tourism. programme.desc: Love is an extremely complex subject, surrounded by numerous “environmental factors” that can alter our dreams and understanding of romance. programme.title: Blessing of Formosa
programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.(n)

programme.desc: Adapted from a true story, the film follows Feng, a determined young man who defies his father to pursue his dream of becoming an automotive mechanic. Alongside his childhood friend Yun, he embarks on a daring journey that unexpectedly plunges them into the exhilarating world of racing, sparking a passionate coming-of-age adventure.(n)
